scheme_name: Scheme for Assistance for Research & Development Activities: Assistance for Contract/Sponsored Research Work
other_conditions: Institution must be a Research and Development institution recognized by CSIR or DSIR
Institution may be set up by the Government of Gujarat or the Government of India
Institution must be AICTE‑approved (including autonomous colleges or those affiliated with universities)
Any other institution approved by the State Level Empowered Committee (SLEC) is eligible
Proposals must be for contract/sponsored research by eligible institutions from industrial associations, individual industrial undertakings, government or any other agency approved by SLEC
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to 50% of the project cost, capped at INR 5,000,000 per project.
